newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Constantin Verros briefed on Tuesday's Energy Council. He said there would be an open debate on the Commission's green paper on renewable energy sources at 1200/1100 GMT. He said there would also be an orientation debate on regulations for a single market in natural gas and that the Council should normally adopt the Synergy multi-annual programme unanimously.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi said the ECOFIN Council would discuss Nordic exemptions to EU alcohol imports rules which allow Finland, Denmark and Sweden to maintain higher taxes on these products and to limit imports to a smaller amount than applicable in other member states. She said the Commission would propose extending these exemptions up to June 30, 2000 for Sweden and June 30, 2002 for Finland and Denmark. Olivi added that the Commission would nevertheless have the possibility in 2000 to propose the Council allow Sweden a final extension of the exemptions up to 2002.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1109: 104 LIFE environment projects selected for 1996.
- Speech/96/315: Speech by Commissioner Emma Bonino at the conference on dialogue between companies and consumers in Europe.
